description: Active product of the given type published and searchable on the store, with both given highlights (Highlights attribute options) assigned and active, so PLP and Quick View show their badges. KB: Highlights; Product attributes (Highlights).

productType.description: Product type: simple, bundle, grouped or configurable

highlight1Code.description: Highlight code (ZnodeHighlight.HighlightCode = Highlights option code), e.g. BIOCertified; outputs highlight1*

highlight2Code.description: Second highlight code, e.g. WaterSenseCertified; outputs highlight2*

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

highlight3Code.description: Optional third highlight code the product must also have active, e.g. FreeShipping; outputs highlight3*. Left out: any
